notes: Key Features lists data rate 9.95-1.3 Gbps (likely typo for 11.3 Gbps). Operating case temperature has C-temp (0 to +70°C), E-temp (-5 to +85°C), and I-temp (-40 to +85°C); temp_min_c/temp_max_c reflect I-temp ordering option. Minimum receiver sensitivity (-24 dBm) specified at 10.709 Gbps, 1E-12 BER, OSNR>35 dB back-to-back. Alternate Prmin row (-300~+1400 ps/nm) gives 0 to -21 dBm without separate BER/OSNR. Shuttered output power max -35 dBm. Frequency accuracy ±2.5 GHz EOL. Optical power stability ΔPo -1.0 to +1.0 dB all channels SOL. Absolute maximum optical receiver input +5 dBm average.
